lede.zh: 本报告聚焦 Qwen3.6-27B W8A8 在 8×Ascend 910B4 上的长上下文、并发与 ShareGPT 服务表现。
lede.en: This report covers long-context, concurrency, and ShareGPT serving behavior for Qwen3.6-27B W8A8 on eight Ascend 910B4 accelerators.

snapshot.zh: 250K 输入并发 1/2/4 · ShareGPT 并发 1/4/16/64
snapshot.en: 250K input at C1/2/4 · ShareGPT at C1/4/16/64

heading.zh: 结果必须连同上下文长度阅读
heading.en: Read each result with its context length

intro.zh: 所有数据来自 Qwen3.6-27B W8A8。长上下文单独列明输入长度、输出长度、并发与并行布局；ShareGPT 为不同请求分布。
intro.en: All measurements are for Qwen3.6-27B W8A8. Long-context results specify input/output lengths, concurrency, and parallel layout; ShareGPT is a distinct request distribution.

note.zh: 250K 并发仅有 2/4/8 个请求；ShareGPT 各并发点为两次观测。部分探索测试样本有限，不能视为稳定容量或服务等级目标。
note.en: The 250K concurrency points contain only 2/4/8 requests; ShareGPT points have two observations each. Treat these as limited measurements, not stable capacity or service-level guarantees.

heading.zh: 250K 输入下并发提升先增加吞吐，随后进入延迟拐点
heading.en: Concurrency raises throughput at 250K input, then reaches a latency knee

intro.zh: 固定输入 250,000 tokens、输出 128 tokens；TP4×2，MNB token block 8,192。每个并发档分别执行 2/4/8 个请求。
intro.en: Fixed 250,000-token input and 128-token output; TP4×2 with an 8,192-token MNB block. The three concurrency points ran 2/4/8 requests.

notes.zh: C1→C2 输出吞吐约翻倍；C4 时 TTFT P99 与 TPOT 明显上升，不能把 C4 视为低延迟容量点。
notes.en: Output throughput nearly doubles from C1 to C2; TTFT P99 and TPOT rise sharply at C4, so C4 is not a low-latency capacity point.

notes.zh: 样本量很小，P99 仅作为本轮观测，不足以形成稳定尾延迟承诺。
notes.en: Sample counts are small; P99 is a run observation, not a stable tail-latency guarantee.

hint.en: Hover a point to inspect the measurement.

body.zh: C4 的 P99 TTFT 达到 222.13 s，TPOT 为 521.2 ms；吞吐反而低于 C2。这一档提示排队/资源压力已成为主要因素。
body.en: At C4, TTFT P99 reaches 222.13 s and TPOT is 521.2 ms; throughput is lower than C2, indicating queuing/resource pressure dominates.

heading.zh: 并行布局改变长上下文承载与首 token 延迟
heading.en: Parallel layout changes long-context capacity and time to first token

intro.zh: 同一权重与引擎，比较 TP4×2 与 TP8×1 的 250K 单请求点；本节是部署布局对照，不是权重横评。
intro.en: Same checkpoint and engine, comparing TP4×2 and TP8×1 at 250K single-request input. This is a deployment-layout comparison, not a checkpoint comparison.

notes.zh: TP8×1 的 KV token pool 单副本更大；TP4×2 在 C2 下报告的总吞吐更高。布局选择仍需结合服务并发目标。
notes.en: TP8×1 exposes a larger KV token pool per replica; TP4×2 reports higher aggregate throughput at C2. Select a layout based on serving concurrency needs.

title.zh: 250K 输入：不同并行布局的首 token 延迟

hint.en: Hover a point to inspect the measurement.

heading.zh: ShareGPT 下并发增长伴随首 token 与解码延迟增加
heading.en: Under ShareGPT, higher concurrency raises first-token and decode latency

intro.zh: ShareGPT 输入约 220、输出约 440 tokens；TP4×2、vLLM-Ascend v0.18.0rc1。每点两次测量，表中为原始两次观测，不做误差外推。
intro.en: ShareGPT prompts average about 220 input and 440 output tokens; TP4×2 on vLLM-Ascend v0.18.0rc1. Each point has two runs; both observations are shown without extrapolating uncertainty.

notes.zh: 并发 64 时输出吞吐达到约 634 tok/s，但 TTFT P99 两次观测分别为 3.16 s 和 3.87 s。
notes.en: At C64, output throughput is about 634 tok/s, while TTFT P99 observations are 3.16 s and 3.87 s.

body.zh: 这是自然长度的 ShareGPT 请求分布，不等同固定输入/输出容量压测；结果依赖数据集长度分布与服务配置。
body.en: This is a natural-length ShareGPT request mix, not a fixed-length capacity benchmark; results depend on prompt lengths and serving configuration.

methodIntro.zh: 单机 8×Ascend 910B4；数据取自 2026 年 7 月的专项长上下文与自然负载实验。
methodIntro.en: Single system with eight Ascend 910B4 accelerators; data comes from the July 2026 long-context and natural-load experiments.

methodNotes.zh: 长上下文点的请求数较少，P99 是当前测试运行的观测值，不足以给出可靠尾延迟分布。
methodNotes.en: Long-context sample counts are small; P99 values describe these runs and do not establish a reliable tail-latency distribution.

methodNotes.zh: 来源机器标识、网络信息与实验路径均未纳入报告。
methodNotes.en: Machine identifiers, network details, and source paths are omitted.
